content.short: Stay up to date with Cardano events, tailored to your individual preferences in your native calendar app.
content.description:
The Cardano Calendar shows events from various categories, like Meetups, Conferences, Software-Releases, Staking, Research Papers, Catalyst, Twitter Spaces, and many more.

You can customise the calendar to your needs by de/activating event categories. You can subscribe with your individual settings and access your favourite events in your native calendar app.
